fields.title: 📖 Athar refutation: The hadith is not abandoned because of opinion
fields.body:
🖋️ **Imām ash-Shāfiʿī** said:

> ***“Imām ash-Shāfiʿī said in meaning: If the hadith is authentic, then that is my madhhab.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** The athar refutes blind fanaticism. No madhhab stands above the authentic proof.

immutable.source: 📝 Ibn al-Qayyim, Aʿlām al-Muwaqqiʿīn, Aussagen der Imāme zur Befolgung des authentischen Hadith.
